Bbq Chicken Gizzards & Livers
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, April 12, 2010 - 1:31am

Ingredients




1 (1 lb.) container chicken gizzards
livers
1 (1 lb.) bacon
1 jar favorite BBQ sauce

Preparation

1 Wrap each gizzard/liver with bacon. Secure with toothpick. Place in shallow baking pan. Cover with BBQ sauce. Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Cover again with BBQ sauce; turn off oven and let set in hot oven another 15 minutes.
